objective: Replace supplied TCS2-4 available-water observations with checked derivation from committed water content and immutable supplied root geometry/retention tables, while retaining the same timing equations and DCS2 event lifecycle.
design: Add an explicit profile-aware source composition that calls evaluate_root_zone_water_deficit_checked for AWLH/AWMH/AWAH, overwrites only a local copy of those three observation fields, then calls the existing TCS1-4 source bridge. Bootstrap supplies the hydraulic view from the same committed snapshot as the event. Do not create a second water-state owner or duplicate aggregation equations. Pending gifts and non-selection intervals must not require new root-water calculation.
gates: Derived versus explicitly supplied reference aggregates produce identical source/event outputs for TCS2-4.
Invalid geometry fails closed without mutation or forcing.
Pending continuation does not consume new selector observations.
Bounded hydraulic/restart/rollback integration follows only after source-composition checks pass at O0/O2.
non_goals: Automatic crop/root growth, TCS1 daily stress accumulation, TCS5/6, DCS1 gift depth, calendar/parser, solute transport or canonical admission.
